title: Return Noble USDC escrow to the migration multisig and freeze the Juno USDC voucher
summary: Circle ends USDC support on Noble; the full pause is on 2027-01-12. This proposal returns all Noble USDC vouchers (ibc/4A482FA914A4B9B05801ED81C33713899F322B24F76A06F4B8FE872485EA22FF) still in circulation on Juno to Noble over channel-224 (MsgReturnToNoble, amount 0 = the full return cap), releasing the matching USDC from Noble escrow to the multisig noble1REPLACE_WITH_MULTISIG. In the same execution it disables bank sends of the voucher, so the holder snapshot is the height emitted by the usdcmigration_return_to_noble event. Holders are repaid off-chain from that snapshot: REPLACE_WITH_REPAYMENT_PLAN_URL.
